Station

The search for a station that sends now runs by itself when the chosen station sends nothing for 25 seconds.

Alarm rules

Three stations are watched while live: NK.KKN, IO.EVN and IN.SHL (open and sending when checked on 13 Nov 2026). The waveform panel and the alarm rules use one station at a time: the one with the newest signal, or the one picked on the map. The other two are read every 3 minutes, so a signal there shows up to 3 minutes late. The limits below were set for NK.KKN and are untested at the other stations.

Notice: a new event appears in the lists. Warning: a long, very slow signal reaches the station before any list entry, or a listed event does not look like an ordinary earthquake. Alarm: a listed event in glacier terrain shows at least two of the signs below, or the shaking has not faded half an hour after it began.

Signs: the shaking builds up slowly; it is very slow (much of its energy below 0.2 Hz); it lasts much longer than usual for the magnitude and distance; it does not fade, or grows again. The limits were set on 11 Nov 2026 from the public record of station NK.KKN (Kakani, Nepal): the Rasuwa collapse of 26 Aug 2026 and six earthquakes of magnitude 4.3 to 5.6 at 200 to 440 km. Seven events are a small sample, and other stations may need other limits.

Connection log

About

Prototype for a class project. It is not a warning system and must not be used as one. Alarms from a past record are labelled REPLAY.

Event lists: EMSC SeismicPortal (CC BY 4.0) and USGS Earthquake Hazards Program. Waveforms: EarthScope and GEOFON (GFZ) data services and the operators of the station shown. Glaciers: Randolph Glacier Inventory 7.0, regions 13 to 15, outlines dated 1989 to 2010, simplified to about 80 m; the alarm rule uses the same inventory reduced to 0.05° cells. Rivers: derived from the terrain model of the project (basins over 400 km²); in flat land the lines can lie beside the real channel. Borders: COD-AB (Nepal) and Natural Earth 10m (other countries), as drawn in the sources; disputed sections are not marked. Waveform reading: seisplotjs 3.2.7 (MIT). Times are UTC; Nepal time is UTC + 5:45. Waveform panel: top, ground motion with signals shaded and the expected first waves of listed events dashed; bottom, frequency from 0 to 10 Hz with the limit for very slow shaking in red.
